متفرقات.description: Artificial intelligence has changed how audio and video are created and shared. متفرقات.title: Re-visioning the Heroine as a Subject in Multinational Women’s Cinema: A Feminist Comparative Study of Marguerite Duras’s Nathalie Granger, Sofia Coppola’s Lost in Translation, and Narjiss Nejjar’s Dry Eyes
متفرقات.description: Drawing on the feminist concept of genealogical continuity, this article situates the French Marguerite Duras (Nathalie Granger, 1972), American Sofia Coppola (Lost in Translation, 2003), and Moroccan Narjiss Nejjar (Dry Eyes, 2003) within a lineage of female art and culture that transcends geographical and linguistic boundaries, cultivating what Elaine Showalter identifies as a “female culture,” meaning a collective shaped by shared feminine, feminist, female experiences, values, and struggles.
